title: Energy quantization for Dirac systems over non-collapsed degenerating Einstein manifolds
summary: We study energy quantization for a class of Dirac systems on compact spin Einstein manifolds of dimension \(n\). For a sequence of solutions to a nonlinear Dirac system with uniformly bounded energy on a fixed spin Riemannian manifold, we first establish an energy identity theorem. We then investigate the more complicated case of underlying domain manifolds being a sequence of non-collapsed degenerating spin Einstein manifolds.
